meta.revisionPolicy: Survey estimates are final on release. The 2025 round moved to a calendar-year reference period: a separate bundle.
meta.coverage: All India, unincorporated service enterprises by activity, per 1,000 establishments: type of ownership, owner's social group, location, nature of operation, months operated, hours worked, registration; the calendar-year 2025 round
meta.note: MoSPI ASUSE, as published: counts are estimated numbers, money is ₹ per year, distributions are per 1,000 establishments. Keys read indicator__dimension__activity__sector__establishment type. The 2025 round covers January to December 2025, a calendar year, and is never joined to the financial-year rounds. GVA per establishment is baked for all establishments only (the source's HWE and OAE rows are mislabelled).
